_comment: The only clauses this skill lets a document cite without a person checking the text. Pointers, not quotations: never quote regulatory text from memory. Print it with: node scripts/citation-check.cjs --list. How to use it: references/regulatory-anchors.md.

watch.note: A revision (together with a revised Chapter 4 and a new Annex 22 on artificial intelligence) was in public consultation from 7 July to 7 October 2025. A web search on the date above found no adopted text, and EudraLex Volume 4 still listed the 2011 text. The draft renumbers and adds clauses, so open EudraLex Volume 4 before a clause number goes into a document that will be signed.

One consolidated Q1 guideline (to replace Q1A to Q1F and Q5C) was in consultation in 2025 and had not reached Step 4 when searched on the date above. Until it is adopted and implemented in the region, Q1A(R2) to Q1E are the texts to cite.

This list says which clause numbers can exist, not which revision is current. For a signed document, a person opens the source (eCFR for 21 CFR, EudraLex Volume 4, picscheme.org, ich.org, ISPE for GAMP) and confirms the number and its text.
